$schema-note: Raw source-shaped fixture, pre-sanitization. mintMark is null on purpose (NBU coins carry no mint mark); the import script normalizes it to ''. Each coin's subject lives in `variety` because the Coin natural key (country, denomination, year, mintMark, variety) has no per-coin name, and several commemoratives share a year and denomination.

sources.origin: uCoin.net catalog: Ukraine, State of Ukraine 1992-2026, 'Commemorative coins' filter (en.ucoin.net/catalog/?country=ukraine&period=54&type=2), 31 coins as of 2026-09-28
sources.license: uCoin's footer prohibits republishing its text and images, so nothing from uCoin is copied here: it was used only to decide which coins are in scope. Subject names are our own English renderings of the NBU's official Ukrainian titles; no uCoin images.

sources.type: coin identity, issue years, mintages and physical specs
sources.origin: Ukrainian Wikipedia '10 гривень (монета)' (uk.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_гривень_(монета)), which cites National Bank of Ukraine releases
sources.license: Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0; only facts (subject, year, mintage, specs) are reproduced, which aren't copyrightable (docs/catalog-data-licensing.md §1); the app footer's Wikipedia credit covers attribution.

sources.origin: NV Business report on the NBU's 28 July 2026 issue of the 'In Memory of Those Executed, Tortured or Killed in Captivity' coin (biz.nv.ua)
sources.license: Used only to confirm the 2,000,000 mintage and zinc-alloy/nickel-plated composition; nothing reproduced.

specs-note: Covers only the second-type (2022+) 23.5 mm circulating commemoratives. The 14 first-type 30 mm / 12.4 g coins of 2018-2022 aren't in uCoin's 'Commemorative coins' list and are not included here.
